source.text:
Upon shattering a Stasis Crystal:

Releases 5 Homing Ice Shards in a * pattern, each dealing 46 damage and inflicting x15 [x10] Slow for 2 seconds.
Shards are spread uniformally, with one shard going towards the closest enemy and the others spreading.

Enemy Shatters deal 12.5% [5%] increased damage.
Crystal Shatters deal 25% [10%] increased damage.
